description: A Python script implementing a Streamlit-based chatbot interface that integrates with various language models and SQL databases to handle user queries, especially related to a specific database 'sql_bot'. It sets up environment variables, database connections, language models, and defines functions for token counting and chat interaction.

methods.name: count_tokens
methods.description: A function that combines a prompt template with a user query, runs it through a chain, and returns the result while tracking token usage.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main function that runs the Streamlit app, handling user input, displaying chat messages, and invoking the token counting function.
